recap.text: The leaderboard goes up and Florin is fourth. He is a level twenty-four Crocodilian Shotgun Messenger with three hundred thousand. He would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned.

Lucia sets dogs on Florin, but his shots do not hurt them. Ifechi casts protection on Florin and a stranger, leaving herself without it and losing her head. Florin takes her leech staff and receives a gold skull from the dungeon. He clears three castles alone and meets Carl after Elle tells him about a man and a cat helping people in wheelchairs.

Florin learns Lucia survived and claims her as his own target on a bathroom paper plan. He cannot equip pulse rifles and electric armor from two blue Goriffs with trunks on their heads. Florin refuses to go down the stairs when the queen takes Ifechi's face. He fights the queen with a shotgun, firing on the beat until her shield stutters and she falls to a knee.

Florin leaves Katia's party in Ecuador with a shotgun upgrade and a quest to kill or capture a Unique. He captures a drunk Unique who raises zombies, but the Unique shoots Florin in the stomach, so Florin slides the card to Donut. Florin walks through a door with claymores and tells Carl that Lucia buys alcohol and teleport traps. Li Jun says Lucia took out half the keyless squads.

Donut makes Florin a General, and he organizes a hierarchy where dancers are Sergeant First Class. Florin calls a twenty-five foot caiman to heave up a buried wall section. He prepares a castle for a siege and captures two rolling boom boxes called Weepers. Florin parties with a sobbing Lucia and refuses to take a deal that would lock him in stasis.

Florin and Lucia win a heat in a tuk-tuk with tech shield, all-terrain and vertical-climb tires, and a GPS upgrade. Florin puts a shotgun to a mage's head to learn why he needs crawlers. After a race with Team Sparkles, Florin and Lucia enter a ring in her father's house. An AI breaks their legs for a C effort. Lucia Mar carries an unconscious Florin down the stairwell to the twelfth floor.

beats.headline: Fourth on the board
beats.text: They put the leaderboard up tonight and I am on it. Fourth. Crocodilian, Shotgun Messenger, level twenty-four, three hundred thousand. I don't know what they showed to get me there. I wasn't doing anything I would call footage. I would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.
beats.gist: Florin is a level twenty-four Crocodilian Shotgun Messenger ranked fourth on the leaderboard.

beats.headline: Ife, and the warehouse
beats.text: Lucia blocked the stairs and set the dogs on me, and I fired. At her, at both dogs, again and again. None of it hurt them. Ife was against the wall with her head gone. She'd cast her protection on me and on a stranger and kept none for herself. The dungeon gave me the kill; there's a gold skull over my head for it. In the warehouse I sat down in the corner with her leech staff across my lap. I didn't spin anything. I leaned my head on the wall and went to sleep.
beats.gist: Florin fires at Lucia and two dogs, but the shots do not hurt them.

beats.headline: Everybody else in the bubble is dead
beats.text: I finally come out into a quadrant. Everybody else in my bubble is already dead. Not most of them. All of them. That leaves the castles, and one man to take them. I have cleared one so far. I am working my way through the rest. The general view is that I am screwed. I keep going.
beats.gist: Florin enters a quadrant where everyone else in his bubble is dead and clears one castle.

beats.headline: The last rescue of phase one
beats.text: I took three of the castles on my own. The air one I could not. I was the last rescue of the first phase; I have the club because of Ifechi. Before the stairs I came to meet Carl. I was done. I had nothing. Then Elle told me about a man and his cat who stopped everything to help old people in wheelchairs, and meant to use an artifact to get people out of their bubbles. Ife was not the only good one. I might die tomorrow, but not because I have given up. If he ever needs a backup gun, I am in his debt.
beats.gist: Florin tells Carl he took three castles and owes Ifechi for his club.

beats.headline: He asks if Lucia lived
beats.text: I am in the back corner of Carl's space when he and Donut come in from the fight. I ask the one thing I want to know. Lucia survived? I did not see a notification. Donut says yes, that she's a cheater like Quan Ch and she got away. Good, I say. I push off the wall and go out into the guildhall common area. They all watch me go.
beats.gist: Florin asks Carl and Donut if Lucia survived, and Donut says she cheated to get away.

beats.headline: Gear I can't wear
beats.text: Two Goriffs, blue, trunks on their heads. Pulse rifles and electric armor. The armor didn't cover their faces. I have their gear now and I can't equip any of it. It's locked to the dead owners. Mordecai says that's common on sponsor items. There's a scroll called Cracker Jack that frees it, and nobody has one. We keep collecting. Carl's still talking. Quit jawing and get on with it.
beats.gist: Florin kills two blue Goriffs with trunks on their heads and collects their pulse rifles and electric armor.

beats.headline: Lucia Mar is mine
beats.text: Carl's plan goes round on the paper in the bathroom and everyone signs it. Goal five is kill Lucia Mar, because she is too dangerous and a wildcard. I sign under it. I am claiming Lucia Mar for myself. If someone attempts to stop me, we will have a problem. That is the whole of what I write.
beats.gist: Florin signs Carl's bathroom paper plan and claims the kill of Lucia Mar for himself.

beats.headline: He will not go down the stairs
beats.text: The queen has Ifechi's face. Katia says it's her twin sister, and she warns me. Carl reminds me of the rule we all agreed to: if Imogen took the form of someone's loved one, that person goes down the stairs. I tell him to go fuck himself. I don't see his cat going down the stairs. I tell him to back off. I'm fine. I've been pacing for an hour, waiting for this party.
beats.gist: Florin refuses to go down the stairs.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
beats.text: She comes apart and I hold on to her until it passes. Then I tell the others what I have worked out, because somebody has to say it out loud. There is more than one of her in that head. Several. Some of them are children. And the dog matters. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.
beats.gist: Florin tells the others that several people, including children, are inside Lucia and the dog matters.

beats.headline: It's her twin
beats.text: The queen drops Carl and I pick him up. So much for peaceful. Katia was right: it looks like Iffy, but it isn't. It's her twin. I can tell. It's not really her either. Iffy was worried about what had happened to her sister. It's not right, them using her body like that. We have to do something about it. Carl says he's working on it.
beats.gist: The queen drops Carl, and Florin picks him up.

beats.headline: Heave
beats.text: We fight the queen on the beat, the way Carl said: nothing magical, half of us firing on the two and four, the other half on the one and three. Arrows, rocks, my shotgun. Heave! Her shield stutters like a strobe light, cast over and over, and it can't keep up with what we throw. Her health goes into the red. She stops casting the shield and falls to a knee, and her hands crackle red.
beats.gist: Florin and others fight the queen on a beat, throwing arrows, rocks, and shotgun fire.

beats.headline: A Unique in Ecuador
beats.text: I am in Ecuador. I left Katia's party just before the last level broke. I have another upgrade for the shotgun. I am in contact with Lucia. I have no totems yet. I do have a quest: track and kill or capture a powerful Unique that is terrorizing my region. That is all I am saying about my situation.
beats.gist: Florin is in Ecuador with a shotgun upgrade and contact with Lucia.

beats.headline: Six totems and a spare
beats.text: My squad's full: me and six totems, a saber-toothed tiger and a giant caiman called Roy among them. Lucia only talks to me sometimes, but she doesn't attack me on sight anymore. I flagged the one I had the quest for. He was raising zombies out of a village cemetery for fun. I walked up while he was falling-down drunk, handed him a supreme healing potion and said his dad wanted him to drink it. He's undead. I summoned him once and he shot me in the stomach. I'm not keeping him. I slide the card to Donut. Good luck, mate.
beats.gist: Florin has six totems, including a saber-toothed tiger and a giant caiman called Roy.

beats.headline: Claymores by the door
beats.text: Everybody is checking in on the chat. Mine: I'm in my zone alone. I had claymores set up by the entrance, and I didn't have to use them. Nobody to face. I just walk to the door. Lucia isn't here, which means she didn't get a key. Anyone who sees her, say so in chat.
beats.gist: Florin stays alone in his zone and does not use the claymores by the door.

beats.headline: No traps past the door
beats.text: Carl wants to know if a trap will sit in the stairwell chamber, so I go down early. Five by five meters, a glowing stair in the middle. I drop a trap. Error: outside the level, no traps in the stairwell chamber, nice try. Sorry, mate. Lucia buys up every teleport trap on the market; those and alcohol are all she buys. Li Jun says she has taken out half the keyless squads. I ask Carl to message me if he gets word of her.
beats.gist: Florin goes down early to check for traps in a five by five meter chamber.

beats.headline: War Leader III, then General
beats.text: Donut touches each of us to make us officers and lets me set up the hierarchy. I start at War Leader III. After some time with the base system that becomes Colonel, and after Donut tells me to upgrade myself, General. Most of the core group gets the same. The dancers get Sergeant First Class, so they can recruit and command the base troops. I'd named that rank Adjutant. They made me change it. Imani, Elle and I are leaving for headquarters to meet the adjutant.
beats.gist: Donut makes Florin a General after he starts as War Leader III.

beats.headline: The caiman lifts the wall
beats.text: We only get so many officers, so the builders and the crawlers are going in as sergeants and chiefs, which lets them change the camp. Everyone else is legionnaire, with corporals running teams. A wall section goes over and buries itself in the dirt, and I go to help. My card from the last floor still comes once a day. I call him: a giant caiman, twenty-five feet of him. He gets his snout under the wall and heaves it up while the workers push. He times out before long. I come back grumbling about artillery.
beats.gist: Florin calls a twenty-five foot caiman to heave up a wall section buried in the dirt.

beats.headline: The north will not hold
beats.text: Bad news from the northern front. We are holding for now, but without backup we might break in a matter of hours, so I'm preparing to fall back to our fallback position. I've ordered the castle to prepare for a siege, just in case. Could really use some air support, and some of those new NPCs Carl just gathered. He says they're on their way.
beats.gist: Florin reports the north may break in hours and prepares to fall back to a fallback position.

beats.headline: Two Weepers, captured
beats.text: Good news, bad news. We stopped their armor in its tracks and captured two of the rolling boom boxes. Weepers. Like British Mark Vs from the first world war, with a top turret and a single anti-air tube, and super high tech on the inside. Warning Louis to steer clear of them. Bad news: the ones facing Carl know they lost the whole regiment, so they'll move soon. Katia and Bautista are flanking Carl's position with what's left of the 105th, to keep the west open and a corridor of retreat into Shanty Town. Carl asks if we're having fun yet. I'll tell him face to face.
beats.gist: Florin captures two Weepers, rolling boom boxes like British Mark Vs, and warns Louis to steer clear.

beats.headline: Not locked up in stasis
beats.text: I tell Carl he's lucky Lucia only cast two nets. She's the queen of the triple tap. She's still in with the liaisons; we'll see what she settles on when she comes out. Most will take a deal if one's offered. They're tired. Me, I'd rather go down fighting than sit locked up in stasis, and a lot of us feel that way. The big blond barbarian clearing the street won't take one either. He came in with his pregnant wife, and she's up there with the kids. Protecting the kids. It's the most important thing one can do.
beats.gist: Florin tells Carl he would rather fight than sit locked up in stasis.

beats.headline: Partied with Lucia
beats.text: Before the stairs, Lucia sits on the ground sobbing while Imani, the barbarian and I talk to her about taking a deal. I get her to party with me. She says she'll take one. She was sketchy about it. None of us believe she will, so I won't take one either.
beats.gist: Florin gets Lucia to party with him after Imani and a barbarian talk to her.

beats.headline: A tuk-tuk, and a first place
beats.text: Lucia and I drew a tuk-tuk. We came first in the heat anyway and took three regular upgrades instead of the Golden one: a tech shield, all-terrain and vertical-climb tires, and a GPS upgrade. Lucia is at the garage. Since the dogs went she has been flipping personalities a lot. About seventy per cent of the time she is herself and ready to skewer me. The rest, a random kid. She will not say why she did not take a deal. It is her turn to drive, so I have hired a mercenary. Jurgen says he will make the other team understand. I nod.
beats.gist: Florin and Lucia win a heat in a tuk-tuk and take three regular upgrades.

beats.headline: He puts the shotgun to Akuma's head
beats.text: I stay quiet while the mage talks, then I put the shotgun against his head, because he just lied. He left Faction Wars on his own. He can step in and out of floors as he pleases. So why does the most powerful thing in this world need crawlers along? He says to get it out of his face and he'll tell us, and he does. His utopia isn't so much a utopia any more. I knew it.
beats.gist: Florin puts a shotgun to Akuma's head after the mage lies about leaving Faction Wars.

beats.headline: Harrying the unicorn down the tubes
beats.text: Team Sparkles and us, all the way down the track. Lucia Prime is back in the body and driving, and I'm keeping her from actually killing the unicorn and Lucienne. At the drop in the middle I let the trap go on purpose, so everyone behind gets an hour in the basement. Now I have to backtrack for the loop. The unicorn's going for it too. I have Denial of Service missiles, and I'll hit them just as they start it.
beats.gist: Florin lets a trap go to put others in the basement and uses Denial of Service missiles.

beats.headline: Lucia's father's house
beats.text: Lucia worked out that the rings count as magical gates, so anything that sees magic will find them. I pass that on. Then we go through our assigned ring on the sixth floor, and it is in Lucia's dad's house, and she is there too, a small one, sitting on the floor in front of the television, laughing. The real Lucia shut down completely for a moment. I tell the others what we saw. I do not know what this place is.
beats.gist: Florin tells the others that rings count as magical gates before entering Lucia's father's house.

beats.headline: A C effort at best
beats.text: Resolution float. No presentation. No agreement on what the theme means. We ride on the back of Ajib's flatbed with paper flowers and pictures of our families. The girl in Lucia's body today drew her grandfather and her cat; she is from Andorra. The AI decides not to kill us, calls it a C effort at best, and breaks every one of our legs at once. That hurt. We keep going.
beats.gist: Florin rides Ajib's flatbed with paper flowers and family pictures; the AI breaks everyone's legs.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: Stairwell notice. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open. Crawler Florin has gone down them, and I use gone loosely: he was unconscious, and Crawler Lucia Mar carried him. That is the record. He is on the list of crawlers who reached the twelfth floor, and the list does not have a column for how.
beats.gist: Crawler Lucia Mar carried an unconscious Florin down the open stairwells to the twelfth floor.
